에베소서 6:1.content: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

에베소서 6:2.content: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

에베소서 6:3.content: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

에베소서 6:4.content: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

에베소서 6:5.content: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

에베소서 6:6.content: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

에베소서 6:7.content: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

에베소서 6:8.content: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

에베소서 6:9.content: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

에베소서 6:10.content: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

에베소서 6:11.content: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

에베소서 6:12.content: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

에베소서 6:13.content: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

에베소서 6:14.content: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

에베소서 6:15.content: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

에베소서 6:16.content: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

에베소서 6:17.content: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

에베소서 6:18.content: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

에베소서 6:19.content: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

에베소서 6:20.content: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

에베소서 6:21.content: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

에베소서 6:22.content: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

에베소서 6:23.content: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

에베소서 6:24.content: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
